assets.name: bollwerk
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original full-body monster game portrait for Gehstock-Mons, used as an actual character collection card and combat encounter portrait.
Scene/backdrop: deep dark teal seamless studio backdrop and ground, soft atmospheric lighting, subtle ground contact shadow.
Subject: Bollwerk, a COMMON rarity original monster. A stocky squat stone golem with a broad low body, stubby legs, huge simple stone fists, a blunt kind but determined face and dim amber eyes. Carries a very simple worn wooden walking cane. Simple battered gray armor plate on one shoulder, primitive leather strap, mossy green-gray rock surfaces. Modest grounded creature; deliberately sparse geometry and accessories, no magic effects, no horns, no wings, no gemstones. Clearly looks like the weakest and simplest member of a rarity progression.
Color palette: moss green, worn gray stone, brown wood.
Style/medium: polished chunky sculpted 3D mobile strategy videogame character, appealing bold exaggerated geometric forms, heroic toy-like silhouette, thick beveled edges, simplified hand-crafted material detail, richly shaded physically rendered surfaces. Visual language like a high-budget village-building strategy game, entirely original creature design.
Composition/framing: square image 1024x1024. Exactly one full-body creature centered, front three-quarter view with face toward viewer, cane relic clearly visible, entire figure and all accessories completely inside frame with at least 10 percent breathing margin on every side. Eye-level camera. Bold clean silhouette readable at thumbnail size.
Lighting: cinematic soft upper-left key, cool teal rim light and subject-specific restrained magical glow.
Constraints: no text, no typography, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no card border, no cropped limbs/wings/weapon, no other creatures, no gore. Make this a beautiful fully finished game character render.
